rationale: Price is at 99.6% of today's range, essentially pinned at the session high with only 18 minutes to close, creating extreme asymmetry — almost no room to run long and forced liquidation risk at the bell. The last five 1-minute candles show near-zero momentum (range of $0.01-0.02 per bar, declining volume) indicating exhaustion at resistance rather than a breakout with follow-through. With SPY down 1.27% and VIXY up 7.31%, the broad risk-off environment adds downside pressure that makes a long at the high unattractive, while shorting into a stock that has already surged ~10% intraday with only 18 minutes remaining carries gap-close risk.
